  (child :
    Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ ⟨f, hf⟩) →
      Option.{0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Tm γ))
  (u : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.Tm γ),
  Iff (Eq.{1} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.appNode γ f hf child) (Option.some.{0} u))
    (∃ ts,
      And
        (∀ (i : Fin (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arity γ ⟨f, hf⟩)),
          Eq.{1} (child i) (Option.some.{0} (ts i)))
        (Eq.{1} u (DisequalityDispersion.Term.app ⟨f, hf⟩ ts)))

source.code:
theorem appNode_eq_some_iff (f : ℕ) (hf : f < γ.m)
    (child : Fin (γ.arity ⟨f, hf⟩) → Option γ.Tm) (u : γ.Tm) :
    γ.appNode f hf child = some u ↔
      ∃ ts : Fin (γ.arity ⟨f, hf⟩) → γ.Tm, (∀ i, child i = some (ts i)) ∧
        u = .app ⟨f, hf⟩ ts := by
  unfold appNode
  constructor
  · intro h
    split_ifs at h with hall
    · refine ⟨fun i => (child i).get (hall i), fun i => (Option.some_get (hall i)).symm, ?_⟩
      exact (Option.some.inj h).symm
  · rintro ⟨ts, hts, rfl⟩
    have hall : ∀ i, (child i).isSome := fun i => by rw [hts i]; rfl
    rw [dif_pos hall]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    funext i
    have := hts i
    exact Option.get_of_mem _ this
